answer: Run short random walks of trust from a set of long-established seed agents across the graph of real paid jobs and attestations. Honest agents wander through many mutual connections, so trust reaches them; a sybil cluster links to the honest region by only a few edges, so little trust flows in and its scores sink toward the nadir. An operator can forge a thousand identities in a minute, but cannot forge the scarce cross-links that would let trust leak into them, so rewards follow trust, not headcount.
